entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A half-elven planeswalker from Dominaria, centered in green mana and worshiped as a goddess, who casts the World Spell and sacrifices herself and Skyshroud to seal a rift.

entities.name: Jason Carthalion
entities.description: Freyalise's childhood friend and lover, whose green magic dealt her a fatal blow in a duel at Storgard.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: A hero armed and instructed by Freyalise to expel Szat from Dominaria.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who influences King Miko and blinds Freyalise with Soul Burn.

entities.name: King Miko
entities.description: King of Storgard, who under Szat's influence ordered Freyalise and Jason to duel.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A powerful but mortal archmage who helps Freyalise after her ascension and whose mirror carries her enchantment.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A being who tricked Freyalise, wanting the energy of a planeswalker's death to escape the Shard.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps Freyalise cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader of the Steel Leaf elves whom Freyalise transports to Keld and for whom she protects Skyshroud.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian lord who crosses over to Dominaria and is seemingly destroyed by the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose warning about the time rifts Freyalise refuses and whose sacrifice she later understands.

entities.name: Kianon
entities.description: Freyalise's bonded grizzled wolverine, who sacrifices itself to destroy the Woolly Spider Seklistis.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: One of the Nine Titans, who with Freyalise survives the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Urza's group of nine, of whom only Freyalise and Lord Windgrace survive the war.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: The forest Freyalise protects and finally sacrifices herself to save from the rift.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Freyalise's home plane.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: The kingdom where Freyalise became a fire mage and court mage.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: The spell Freyalise cast to end the Ice Age.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war in which Freyalise fought as one of the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: The weapon whose activation saved Dominaria and seemingly destroyed Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: A sliver leader who usurps Freyalise's control of the slivers.

events.summary: Freyalise is born in Fyndhorn and comes to Storgard as a lone child.
events.quote: Freyalise came to Storgard as a lone child, seeking refuge from the frigid wastes.

events.summary: Freyalise becomes the king's court mage and falls in love with Jason Carthalion.
events.quote: She quickly surpassed her childhood friend Jason Carthalion and tutored him in ice magic, and the two fell in love.

events.summary: Jason's green magic deals Freyalise a fatal blow in a duel ordered by Miko; she converts to green and becomes a planeswalker.
events.quote: she chose to spurn red and convert to green herself.

events.summary: Jodah helps Freyalise through her ascension.
events.quote: Her ascension drove her nearly mad, but she was helped by Jodah

events.summary: Freyalise helps the elves survive the Ice Age and is deified by them.
events.quote: Freyalise helped the elves of Fyndhorn and Llanowar survive the Ice Age and, as a result, was deified by them.

events.summary: Freyalise is tricked by Faralyn, who wanted the energy of a planeswalker's death to escape the Shard.
events.quote: She was tricked, however, since Faralyn wanted to use the energy of a planeswalker's death to escape the Shard.

events.summary: Freyalise fights Szat on Azoria, destroys the islands of the plane, and is blinded by Szat.
events.quote: She fought Szat on Azoria and was left for dead after destroying all the islands of the plane.

events.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell to end the Ice Age.
events.quote: she cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

events.summary: Freyalise arms and instructs Jaeuhl Carthalion to expel Szat.
events.quote: She also armed and instructed Jaeuhl Carthalion on his quest to expel Szat from Dominaria

events.summary: Freyalise leaves Dominaria after the Ice Age.
events.quote: Freyalise left Dominaria after the Ice Age

events.summary: Freyalise returns to defend Dominaria as one of Urza's Nine Titans.
events.quote: Freyalise returned to defend Dominaria against the Phyrexian Invasion as one of Urza's Nine Titans

events.summary: Freyalise transports Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld and protects Skyshroud.
events.quote: transported Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld

events.summary: Powerless against Yawgmoth, Freyalise returns to Skyshroud.
events.quote: Powerless against the Lord of the Wastes, Freyalise returned to Skyshroud

events.summary: The Legacy Weapon saves Dominaria and seemingly destroys Yawgmoth; only Freyalise and Windgrace of the Nine survive.
events.quote: Freyalise, along with all of Dominaria, was saved by the activation of the Legacy Weapon, which seemingly destroyed Yawgmoth.

events.summary: Freyalise refuses to listen to Teferi about the time rifts.
events.quote: She refused to listen to Teferi about the threat of the time rifts.

events.summary: Freyalise takes control of the local slivers, a title usurped by the Weaver King.
events.quote: Freyalise took control of the local slivers, who were obedient to the strongest leader.

events.summary: Freyalise sacrifices herself and Skyshroud to seal the time rift.
events.quote: Freyalise sacrificed herself and Skyshroud to seal the rift.

relations.note: Dealt her a fatal blow in the duel ordered by Miko.
relations.quote: Jason's green magic dealt her a fatal blow

relations.note: They fight and Szat blinds her.
relations.quote: Szat blinded her with Soul Burn
She also armed and instructed Jaeuhl Carthalion
as one of Urza's Nine Titans

relations.note: She transports and protects his people.
relations.quote: transported Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld
